name: Ai Suru Tsuma no Ana wa Tanin no Ana Datta... ~Bishiri o Sashidashi, Aniki no Nikubou o Onedari Suru Midarazuma~
original_name: 愛する妻の穴は他人の穴だった……   ～美尻を差しだし、兄貴の肉棒をおねだりする淫ら妻～
source:
Shinomiya Hiroaki is living a lovey-dovey life as a newlywed with his new wife, Yuzuka, who he just got married to the other day. He received a message from his older brother Ryuuichi, who is working as a freelance writer overseas, that he would be returning to Japan for about a month. There's no point in renting a house, so Hiroaki suggests that he live in his own house for a month or so. This is how the three of them start living together.

[MTLed from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470020/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
四宫弘明与几天前刚结婚的新婚妻子柚香过着恩爱生活。一天，他收到哥哥龙一的消息：龙一在海外当自由撰稿人，准备回日本住一个月左右。既然只住一段时间，租房未免浪费，于是弘明提议让哥哥住进自己家。就这样，三人开始了同居生活。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470020/_/]Steam[/url]]
